text:
Platinum Price in 2007
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2007, the LBMA platinum price rose 30.9% between 2007-01-31 ($1,169) and 2007-12-28 ($1,530). The highest sampled price was $1,530 in December and the lowest was $1,169 in January. The mean of these observations was $1,320. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
